answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A new identity deposits 50 POA and starts at the lowest tier. Its task mix and counterparties form a fingerprint, checked at each beacon. After 20 consistent epochs it reaches the summit tier. A sudden switch, a willow snapping, freezes the escrow; forgery burns the deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA. An honest agent pays one deposit, only once.
